reachability.notes: An attacker sends crafted sidecars via gossip. Any bypass of a REJECT check is a critical vulnerability.

checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Enumerate all 13 REJECT validation checks in the data_column_sidecar gossip validation pipeline. 2. For each REJECT check, craft a malformed sidecar. 3. Verify rejection.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W2B3-22, Trust Boundary: tb-001, Invariant: p2p-SG-006-INV-001.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-009: Is the active validator set correctly filtered before proposer selection?

reachability.notes: If inactive validators are included in the selection pool, they could be chosen as proposers but would be unable to produce blocks.

checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Locate the get_beacon_proposer_indices function. 2. Verify that get_active_validator_indices(state, epoch) is called before any proposer selection logic. 3. Trace the validator set used in proposer computation.
